anti_bias_rules: Candidate membership is frozen before baseline execution.
No candidate may be removed because a baseline fails, times out or errors.
The same correct implementation, frozen mutant and input domain must be supplied to all methods.
Absence of a counterexample is never reported as proof for search-based baselines.
Runtime comparisons are reported separately from guarantee strength.

excluded.reason: No standalone frozen mutant function located.
No standalone frozen adapter and mutant pair located.

interpretation.BIZPROOF_PROVED: formal proof within the frozen supported semantic slice
interpretation.CrossHair_NO_COUNTEREXAMPLE: inconclusive; no counterexample reported under configured budget
interpretation.Hypothesis_NO_COUNTEREXAMPLE: inconclusive; no counterexample found under configured budget

primary_tier.claim_scope: Tool-capability comparison only; not an estimate of population-level generalization across repositories.
primary_tier.eligibility_rule: Frozen V0.11 CERTIFIED_A2; standalone adapter and mutant; same function signature; all adapter inputs are int/bool scalars, or the function has zero inputs.
primary_tier.name: STRICT_CORE

secondary_tier.name: EXTENDED_TYPED
secondary_tier.reason_secondary: Requires additional harness support for Optional, Decimal, tuple, frozenset or domain-specific types.
